newsitem.title: UK: UK's Brown to appoint second BOE deputy governor.
newsitem.headline: UK's Brown to appoint second BOE deputy governor.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown said on Tuesday the government will appoint a second deputy governor to the Bank of England.

"The (Bank of England's) monetary policy committee will set the interest rate. That committee will include the governor, the deputy governor, a second deputy governor to be added by the legislation, two executive officials of the Bank and four new members added because of their economic expertise," Brown told reporters at a news conference.
Brown said he confirmed the contract for the present Bank governor Eddie George, which runs until June 1998.
He added that there would be no government minister on the nine-person monetary policy committee. "There is no politician on that committee."
